These terms apply to haykalah.com in English and Arabic, and to the tools on it. The website is published by HAYKALAH Financial Advisory, Commercial Registration No. 7014123751, Riyadh and Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. By using the website you accept these terms. If you do not accept them, please do not use the website.

01Website disclaimer

Information only. All figures are indicative and subject to audit confirmation; project values are the size of the client project as recorded, not capital raised by HAYKALAH. Nothing on this website is an offer, a solicitation or investment advice. No guarantee of financing, returns, approvals or outcomes. Shariah structures are subject to Shariah board approval. Regulated activities are executed through appropriately licensed partners.

02No offer or solicitation

Nothing on this website is an offer to sell, or a solicitation of an offer to buy, any security, fund unit, token or other investment, in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia or anywhere else. HAYKALAH does not offer investments. Structures, frameworks and cases are described to explain how HAYKALAH works, not to invite anyone to invest in them.

03Regulated activities

HAYKALAH is not an Authorised Person of the Capital Market Authority. Where a transaction involves securities business regulated by the CMA, such as arranging, dealing, managing or advising on securities, or establishing or managing an investment fund, that activity is carried out by a CMA-authorised institution engaged for the transaction. Our regulatory status page explains this in full.

Regulatory status

Regulated activities are executed through appropriately licensed partners.

04Shariah approval

HAYKALAH designs Shariah-compliant structures, such as Sukuk, Ijara, Istisna’a, Musataha, Wakala and Waqf. HAYKALAH does not maintain its own Shariah board. Each structure is reviewed and approved by the Shariah board of the issuer, fund or financial institution involved; where a client has none, HAYKALAH can arrange an independent Shariah board for the transaction. No structure is final until that approval is given.

05Figures, cases and examples

  • All figures are indicative. Project value is the size of the client project as recorded, not capital raised by HAYKALAH.
  • Outcomes are described as “recorded in HAYKALAH files” until they are corroborated with the client.
  • Designed capacity, such as pilgrims, rooms or areas, is what a project was designed for, not a recorded outcome.
  • Proposals and frameworks are not mandates.
  • Clients are not named until they consent in writing.
  • Work from the founder’s career before HAYKALAH is labelled as earlier career.

06No reliance

The content of this website is general information. It is not legal, Shariah, tax, Zakat, accounting or investment advice, and it does not take account of your circumstances. It may be incomplete or out of date. Do not act on it without advice on your own situation. HAYKALAH gives advice only under a signed engagement. To the extent the law allows, HAYKALAH is not liable for any loss arising from use of this website or reliance on its content.

07Tools and Ask HAYKALAH (Beta)

The website offers educational tools. None of them gives investment advice, and none creates an engagement.

  • Ask HAYKALAH (Beta) answers from HAYKALAH’s published pages only, with numbered sources. It is an AI tool in testing: an answer can be incomplete or wrong, so check the source pages it cites. It declines questions about specific investments, returns or recommendations, and offers a hand-off to a person. Do not type personal or confidential information into it. Its answers do not bind HAYKALAH.
  • The Structure Finder points you to the practice and structures that match your answers to two questions. It is an educational guide.
  • The asset readiness check gives a first indication from five questions. It is not advice and not a valuation.
  • Structure explainers show how a structure can work. A framework labelled “Proposal” is a proposal with no mandate.
  • HOAM, HAYKALAH’s opportunity matrix, is a screening tool, not investment advice.

08Intellectual property

The HAYKALAH name and wordmark, the sub-brand names FINA., MARK., AXIS. and AGTI., the 30 HAYKALAH pattern tiles, and the text, diagrams, glossary and other content of this website belong to HAYKALAH or are used with permission.

  • You may view and print pages, and share links to them, for your own reference or your organization’s internal use, with HAYKALAH credited.
  • Any other use, including copying, adapting or republishing content, or using the brand, the tiles or the pattern, needs HAYKALAH’s written permission.
  • Search engines and AI search assistants may read the website to answer questions and cite it with a link. Using the website’s content to train AI models is not permitted.
  • Licensed photographs and video remain the property of their licensors. Some images contain third-party data, such as Copernicus Sentinel data, credited where they appear. Typefaces are used under their own licenses.

09What you send us

Please keep confidential details out of web forms. If a mandate is confidential, ask for an NDA first, and we will send it before we ask for any details. Sending a request does not create an engagement; an engagement starts only when both sides sign an agreement.

10Links to other sites

The website links to other sites, such as HAYKALAH’s LinkedIn page. HAYKALAH does not control those sites and is not responsible for their content or their privacy practices.

11Our official channels

HAYKALAH contacts people only through haykalah.com and from @haykalah.com email addresses. If someone offers you an investment in HAYKALAH’s name, it is not from HAYKALAH.
